verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents H264/H265 hardware codecs alongside VP8/VP9/AV1 software codecs, which covers the hardware-encoding half of the story. Interactive latency rests on mixed anecdotes: heavy daily users report performance better than AnyDesk, including smooth YouTube playback, while others found it extremely laggy or slow via relay servers. missing for 10: first-party documentation of latency targets or low-latency tuning, independent measured latency benchmarks, consistent hands-on reports of responsive interactive use.
